page.title: Brush
page.description: Race new torrents from RSS onto the least busy server and remove the torrents that earn the least.

status.loadFailed: Could not load the brush status: {{message}}
status.saveFailed: Could not change the brush switch
status.settingsHint: Set the safety floor and upload capacity in Settings → Instances → Brush
status.missedSpaceHint: Torrents that passed the filters but no downloader had room for. Many mean more disk or a lower floor would help.
status.missedWindowHint: Torrents already past the race window when seen. Many mean a shorter poll interval would help.

instances.noFloor: Reading the disk; the floor is set shortly
instances.belowFloor: Below the safety floor, adds paused
instances.empty: No qBittorrent instances. Add one under Settings first.

sites.cookieKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved cookie
sites.cookieHelp: Copy the Cookie header from a logged-in browser; brush uses it to check free status and download torrents. It is stored encrypted and never shown again. For M-Team, enter the API key here.
sites.uploadLimitHelp: The fastest the site lets one torrent upload. It is set as the upload limit of every torrent brush adds. Leave empty for none.
sites.downloadLimitHelp: Set as the download limit of every torrent brush adds, to keep downloads from filling the bandwidth or the disk. Leave empty for none.

feeds.title: Feeds
feeds.description: Each feed is polled on its own interval. Only torrents younger than the race window are added.
feeds.name: Name
feeds.urlKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved link
feeds.urlHelp: The link contains your passkey. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
feeds.instancesHelp: Each torrent goes to the least busy checked downloader, comparing spare space above the floor and how busy the upload is. When none of them can take it, the torrent is skipped, never sent to an unchecked one.
feeds.ageFromFirstSeen: Count age from when the feed lists it
feeds.ageFromFirstSeenHelp: For a separate RSS of old torrents that come back, like a revival section: the pubDate is ignored and a torrent is brand new when it first appears in this feed. Leave it off for normal feeds, or old torrents that reappear in the list are added as new.
feeds.noSite: No site yet. Add one on the sites page first.
feeds.siteHelp: The cookie, upload limit and other site settings are edited on the sites page and shared by the site's feeds. Go to
feeds.info: With Free only or Skip H&R on, brush checks the details page first; the rule is picked from the site's address and shown on the sites page.
feeds.dialogDescription: Race new torrents from one RSS feed onto the checked downloaders.
feeds.freeOnlyHelp: Adds a torrent only when its details page shows it free.
feeds.skipHrHelp: Checks the details page and skips torrents with H&R, or when the check fails.
feeds.enabledHelp: When off, the feed is not polled.
feeds.categoryHelp: Torrents are added with this qBittorrent category, created when it does not exist. Leave empty for none.
feeds.groupsHelp: Instances in the chosen groups, now and later, take part in this feed, alongside any instances checked below.

test.title: Test {{name}}
test.description: Reads the feed now and checks the newest torrents on the site. Nothing is added.

history.title: History
history.description: What brush decided for each new torrent, newest first.
history.candidateCost: {{name}}: cost {{cost}} (space {{space}} + upload {{upload}}), upload {{rate}} / {{capacity}} Mbps, {{fresh}} new in the last 2 min
history.empty: Nothing yet. The first poll of a feed only records what it lists.

deletions.title: Deletions
deletions.info: When new torrents need the space, brush deletes the torrents that earn the least, announcing them to the tracker first, except below the safety floor, where space comes first. Only torrents brush added are deleted, and nothing is deleted while brushing is off. Kept for 30 days.

reasons.inspect_failed: could not read the details page
reasons.low_space: not enough space above the safety floor
reasons.site_unavailable: Could not read the site settings

sitesPage.title: Sites
sitesPage.description: What each site's torrents uploaded and downloaded today, what they seed now, and the site's cookie and upload limit. Feeds pick their site on the brush page.
sitesPage.baseUrlHelp: The rule is picked from the address, following the original Vertex's site support; sites without their own rule use the generic NexusPHP rule.
sitesPage.footnote: Counts the torrents on every downloader with a safety floor: the ones brush added belong to their feed's site, the others to the site their tracker's domain matches. Today's totals are written once a minute; speed, torrents and size are live.
sitesPage.dialogDescription: The site's address, login and upload limit, shared by its feeds.

log.title: Brush log
log.description: What brush decided for each new torrent, and the torrents it deleted to make room.

instanceTab.limitsDescription: Brush adds torrents only while the space left after every download stays above the safety floor; the upload capacity tells how busy this downloader is.
instanceTab.floorHelp: A new instance starts at 10% of its disk; change it any time.
instanceTab.capacityHelp: The upload bandwidth the host sells, e.g. 2000 Mbps; empty means placement ignores how busy the upload is.
instanceTab.nowDescription: The space and upload brush reads for this downloader, updated every 5 seconds.
instanceTab.saveFailed: Could not save the brush settings
instanceTab.countryHelp: Where this downloader runs; its flag shows in the dashboard's server statistics.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: How fast brush gets torrents in: from the site's publish to the downloader's confirmation, and how soon they upload.
performance.info: Discovery = site publish → brush first sees it in the RSS, set mostly by the poll interval; processing = first sight → qBittorrent confirms the add, including the free check, the torrent download and the add. Entry is both. Bars are each period's entry P95, amber past {{slow}} s, faded with fewer than 3 torrents. It reports facts only; placement and deletion do not use it.
performance.outcomesHint: Failures and unconfirmed adds counted apart
performance.empty: Brush added no torrent in this period.
performance.drillDescription: {{range}}, {{count}} torrents. Open a row for its timeline from publish to first upload.

flows.title: Flow map
flows.description: Which countries each server is exchanging data with right now, and how fast. Only each server’s busiest torrents are read; peers are grouped by the country qBittorrent resolves.
flows.mapInfo: Pipes join servers and peer countries: a wider pipe moves more now, and its particles run denser and faster, the way the data goes. Only the 40 fastest are drawn. Coloured by direction, cyan pipes carry uploads out and amber ones downloads in; coloured by server, each server has its own colour. Pools are the peer countries themselves: the more a country exchanged today, the paler it is and the higher it rises on the globe. White dots are servers, placed by the region in their instance settings. The peers of each server’s 15 busiest torrents are read every 15 seconds.
flows.mapLabel: Live map of flows between servers and peer countries
flows.waiting: Waiting for the first read, about 15 seconds.
flows.idle: No connection is moving data right now.
flows.noCountry: These servers have no region set, so their flows are not drawn: {{names}}. Set it under Settings → Instances → Brush.
flows.globeHint: Drag to turn, scroll to zoom
flows.groupsHint: Give instances groups under Settings → Instances → Brush and they are grouped here.
flows.countryToday: {{country}}: today up {{uploaded}}, down {{downloaded}}; now {{count}} connections, up {{upload}}, down {{download}}
flows.summarySpread: Traffic is spread out; {{region}} leads with {{share}}.

groups.title: Groups
groups.instanceHelp: Put this instance in one or more groups. Feeds can target a group and then place on every instance in it, and the flow map groups servers the same way.
groups.label: group {{name}}
